name: prompt-pie
description: Bring prompts and single-file skill drafts to a local-first, privacy-friendly Prompt Pie workspace for visual Markdown preview, refinement, and retrieval through the local ppie companion.

interface.shortDescription: Draft prompts and skills with Markdown preview
interface.longDescription: Prompt Pie is a local-first, privacy-friendly workspace for prompts and single-file skill drafts. Connect Codex to send one prompt-sized document for visual Markdown preview and refinement, then retrieve it when ready. Local skill files can stay staged alongside .agents/skills until you finalize them.
defaultPrompt: Send this prompt or single-file skill draft to Prompt Pie.
Get my edited prompt or skill draft.
